songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1: Male Vocal]
The kitchen is blue before sunrise
A match scratches once against the box
Orange moves across the white tile
The kettle catches half the flame
Then the stove takes over quietly

[Refrain: Female Vocal]
The Small Flame Finds the Stove
Before the window finds the morning
A brief orange shape crosses the kettle
Then settles low beneath the grate
The Small Flame Finds the Stove

[Verse 2: Female Vocal]
The match is dark beside the saucer
The burner keeps a smaller blue
Outside the rooftops are still colorless
Inside the metal starts to warm
No other light is needed yet

[Instrumental Break - 4 bars]

[Verse 3: Male Vocal]
Soon the window will turn silver
The match will look like any stick
But for one second it held the room
Between the dark and coming day

[Final Refrain: Male and Female Duet]
The Small Flame Finds the Stove
Then leaves the morning to the window
A little orange, a little blue
And one cold kettle growing warm
The Small Flame Finds the Stove

The kettle wakes before the window
A pale cloud reaches for the glass
Yesterday's ring stays on the table
Fainter now, but still a circle
The room begins from what remained

Steam Comes Back to Glass
Where the first white line once faded
Morning does not start from nothing
It rises through the marks already there
Steam Comes Back to Glass

The blue plate waits beside the cupboard
The apron hangs against the wall
A spoon turns slowly in the new light
The pantry door is closed and dark

The room is briefly soft again
Old circles, cloth, and silver edges
Appear beneath the moving white
